To

All the General Public
Subject: Status of flotation of surplus/surrendered/ cancelled flats of HEWO

GH Site-09, Sector-12, Sonepat and GH-33, Sector-65, Faridabad on

as is where is basis.

In continuation of this office letter No.HEWO/2026/1584 dated 20.01.2026,
on the subject cited above.

It is brought to the notice of all the General Public that surplus/
surrendered/cancelled flats of HEWO GH Site-09, Sector-12, Sonepat and GH-33, Sector-
65, Faridabad were floated on as is where is basis vide this office letter No./HEWO/2026/
1584 dated 20.01.2026. The category, number of flat, area, cost of flats and detailed
terms and conditions for submitting application are mentioned in the aforesaid letter. The
above said circular letter has been hosted on web site of HSVP i.e. www.hsvphry.org.in
at HEWO page. The last date for receipt of applications has been extended upto
19.05.2026. A
